args.report: Moved the start closer to the lake.

ended: Moved the start to the west third, about 17 tiles south of where it was, beside the river. It is now 24 tiles from the lake (was 35). I read "the lake" as the small lake north of the map's centre, the nearest real lake to the start; the big basin just west of the new start is where a dam's reservoir would go. Say if you meant that one. Clean water is 2 tiles away, and every start rule still holds.
